name: session
description: Beta. What a session left behind: a /session pane with files changed, commits, denied calls and the longest gap, a retro band on the next start, and a safe stop for stray claude -p children.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: What to do when a command or write hits a guard rule: confirm (ask the person), deny (block, no ask), off.

guard_extra_protected_branches.title: Extra protected branches
guard_extra_protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branch names a force push is stopped on, besides main, master, trunk and the remote default.

guard_secret_paths.title: Extra secret paths
guard_secret_paths.description: Comma-separated globs (for example secrets/**) a write is stopped on, besides .env files, keys and credential files.

log_enabled.title: Denial log
log_enabled.description: Keep a redacted log of denied calls for /session-denials.
